title: THE LORD WAS WITH HIM IN PRISON

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "the LORD was with Joseph and showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden. So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there. The warden put Joseph in charge, and the prison warden paid no attention to anything under Joseph's care, because the LORD was with him; the LORD gave him success in everything he did." - Gen 39:21-23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter began by telling us "the LORD was with Joseph" in Potiphar's house (v.2). Now it ends by telling us the very same thing in prison: "the LORD was with Joseph." This is the great, steady truth that frames Joseph's whole ordeal. Whether in a comfortable house or an unjust cell, whether rising or falling, one thing never changed — God was with him.

What a comfort this is. God's presence did not depend on Joseph's circumstances. When he was promoted, God was with him. When he was imprisoned for doing right, God was still with him. The prison walls could shut out Joseph's freedom, but they could not shut out his God. And once again, Joseph's faithfulness and God's blessing lifted him up, even in that dark place, until the warden trusted him with everything.

Here is the truth to carry home: there is no place so low, so unfair, or so dark that God cannot be there with His people. Joseph's God is our God, and He has promised, "Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you" (Heb 13:5). Prisons of circumstance cannot separate us from His presence.

And this prison was not a dead end — it was the doorway to Joseph's destiny, for here he would meet the men who led to his rise before Pharaoh. God's presence in your hardest place is quietly preparing something you cannot yet see.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I believe God is with me in my lowest, darkest places?
2. How does "the LORD was with Joseph" in prison comfort me?
3. Where might God be preparing something in my hardest season?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that no place is too dark or unfair for Your presence. Be with me in my lowest seasons as You were with Joseph, and work Your purposes even where I cannot yet see. Amen.
